title: HB0561 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, enacts the "Tennessee Firearms Industry Nondiscrimination Act." - Amends TCA Title 47.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2017-02-07; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514063256 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/110/Bill/HB0561.pdf (LegiScan doc 1499163))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2017-02-07; no Senate twin named in this copy. Borderline for gun_policy: it regulates banking treatment of firearm sellers, not guns themselves; counted as gun policy because it protects firearms commerce. "Qualified product" is defined by reference to 15 U.S.C. 7903(4) (firearms, ammunition, components). Enforced by the attorney general. Draft text: adopted amendments are not in the text read and could change it.
